title: Reduce an amide
hook: Predict the product, then compare the bonds.

knows: Structural formula bonds and common organic functional groups.
doesNotKnow: Lithium aluminum hydride reduces an amide to an amine. The carbonyl oxygen is removed, but the bond between the carbonyl carbon and nitrogen is retained.

misconception: Reaction conditions do not affect the connectivity of the product.
objective: Predict the organic product of ethanamide under the stated conditions and identify the changed connectivity.

claims.text: Question, structural diagrams, product and explanation: Ethanamide is treated with 1. LiAlH₄; 2. water. Which major organic product forms after workup? Lithium aluminum hydride reduces an amide to an amine. The carbonyl oxygen is removed, but the bond between the carbonyl carbon and nitrogen is retained.
The diagrams use condensed labels and depict connectivity rather than molecular geometry; highlighting identifies selected changed groups.
